heading: Gray or white (normal / superior / ethereal / socketed base)
description: Socket count and preparation path. Existing sockets must match a legal useful recipe; they cannot be rerolled to another count. A count that misses one word may fit another: normal ethereal five-socket Thresher, Giant Thresher, Cryptic Axe and Great Poleaxe have supported scoped asks. Three-socket normal non-ethereal Monarchs use the supported socket-pooled fallback under Steering 7: Q1 0.674 Ist / 17 sellers (2026-10-04 scoped asks), SELL (slow). This is a relaxed socket comparison, not an exact three-socket quote or a claim of Spirit eligibility. One- or two-socket elite armor is not automatically a runeword candidate; an exact sparse market quote may warrant review separately from recipe use. For 0os, check native item-level brackets before promising Larzuk: Giant Thresher and Phase Blade have maxima 3/4/6, Berserker Axe 4/5/6, Monarch 3/3/4 and Colossus Voulge 3/4/4 for ilvl 1–25 / 26–40 / 41+. Unknown item level leaves the outcome conditional. Eligible normal-quality unsocketed equipment may instead use the cube socket recipe; superior and low-quality equipment cannot. Unsocketed, prepared and already-socketed copies keep separate price evidence.

heading: Gray or white (normal / superior / ethereal / socketed base)
description: Read the roll. Superior: 15% ED is a separate top-roll bucket; 5–14% ED is not automatically priced as normal. Compare supported quality/ED cohorts, without borrowing the 15% premium. Ethereal: compare mercenary/runeword demand separately from character durability; polearms and mercenary armor can carry a premium, while Spirit/Enigma character bases need their own non-ethereal comparison. Automods: 45@ on Paladin shields (40–44 still sells, <40 floor). An alternative paid pattern on Sacred Targe / Sacred Rondache is the top native damage/attack-rating tier: 51–65% damage together with 101–121 attack rating. Cached scoped asks support this pattern; compare both rolls, sockets, ethereal status and superior defense separately. One or two comparable sellers mean CHECK, not a reliable sell price. For other clean socketed bases without an existing guide rule, two independent scoped sellers above the keep threshold establish an exact-variant CHECK candidate when a non-starter runeword recipe is legal. Preserve base, quality, ethereal status, sockets and all modifiers; one isolated seller does not establish this pattern. Three sellers remain necessary for SELL (slow). Other automods: +3 Bow skills on Amazon bows, Warlock staff-mods on daggers (§7). Unsocketed +3 Battle Orders helms, +3 Lightning Sentry claws, +3 Energy Shield staves, +3 Abyss grimoires and +3 Bone Spear wands warrant CHECK only when the socket data allows a useful outcome. Low item levels can cap helms/claws at two sockets; superior bases cannot use the cube socket recipe. Unknown levels remain conditional, and an unsocketed candidate never borrows a socketed-base price. Other paid class-base patterns include three empty sockets with +3 Tornado, Volcano or Armageddon on a Druid pelt, or +3 Find Item on a Barbarian helm. Five-socket +3 Energy Shield staves are Call to Arms candidates; four-socket copies belong to Memory. Two-socket grimoires with +3 Abyss, Apocalypse or Summon Defiler also have scoped market evidence. Keep other staffmods in the comparison; do not borrow another base, ethereal variant or skill combination’s price. Lower rolls of the complete pattern warrant CHECK, not the top-roll price.

heading: 2.4 Reign of the Warlock bases (thin-market flags, WP-G/WP-B)
description: Grimoires (BS-grimoire): Warlock-only off-hand, 15 bases in 3 tiers (new-items 2026-02-19); 0–3 staff mods of +1–3 on any rarity (warlock-overview 2026-02-18). Only Vigilance (Dol-Gul, D tier, no S/A build) fits; the maxroll sockets table has no grimoire row (Traderie shows 0/1/2os across 358 listings; 2 = the observed maximum). Price = the roll, never the base tier (2os white medians, one vote per seller, 2026-09-18: Grimoire 3.3 (n=29) · Possessed 5.0 (n=15) · Blasphemous 1.0 (n=10, 1 priced) — pricing/data/addendum-2026-09-18-session.json). Three roll brackets: rare with +2 to Warlock Skills (108 listings, 75 rare; med 4.05, max 457 — the only route to triple-digit asks, always with +3 to a key skill on top) · magic with +3 to a tree (Demon / Chaos / Eldritch Skills; 2.4 → 51, n=19) · white / superior 2os with +3 to a demanded skill: Summon Tainted 8.2 → 118 (2 sellers), Consume 1 → 29 (2), Bind Demon 5.9 → 10.4 (4), Sigil: Death 5.9 → 9.3 (5); the common +3 Abyss / Apocalypse rolls sit at 5 (n=30 / 24); Enhanced Entropy, Engorge, Summon Defiler, Blood Boil are floor. No staff mods = vendor (6 of 358 listed; automod-free grimoires do drop — a Superior Codex with only fire damage + durability was seen in-game 2026-09-18). Demand is the Abyss / Fire / summoner Warlocks: the S-tier Echoing Strike guide (2026-08-26) equips shields (Spirit, Lidless Wall, Splendor, Ancients' Pledge, Rhyme) for the 125 % FCR breakpoint and names a "Book" only in its Starter variant; a Rhyme Codex is self-use, the runes remove the base's value.

Void is Indestructible → ethereal is free damage; Ritual is not. cells: Heart of the Oak (Ko-Vex-Pul-Thul) in the 4os Flail in shared stash tab 3
1–2.6 finished (Traderie asks 2026-09-24, 24 sellers, 33–36 res rolls) or ~3.5 in runes (Vex 2.5 · Pul 0.8 · Ko 0.25)

Re-measured 2026-09-29 from the collection DB (clvl 92: Shako+Um · Bitter Talisman +2 Warlock / 33 poison, no FCR · Authority Mage Plate +2 Warlock / 30 fire · Wizardspike · Spirit 27 · Raven Frost · Havoc Eye 28 fire / 10 FCR · Arachnid · IK Pillar · Trang-Oul's · Anni 18 · 8@ LC; sheet 127 FCR, all res 75). Item FCR is exactly 127 (Wiz 50 + Spirit 27 + Trang 20 + Arachnid 20 + Havoc Eye 10), so HotO (40) lands at 117 — below 125. Raw resists minus Wizardspike + HotO 30–40: fire 71–81, cold 66–76, lightning 36–46, poison 69–79 (the earlier fire gap is gone: Authority and Havoc Eye added 58 fire). Two things need fixing: +8 FCR and +29–39 lightning res. Fix in hand: Raven Frost → Blood Turn (shared stash tab 1: 10 FCR, 17 light, 28 poison, +4 replenish) gives 127 FCR, poison and fire/cold capped, lightning 53–63; then IK Pillar → Natalya's Soul (on CybergrindMUniq: 17 light / 19 cold, same 40 FRW, −44 life) or two 11-light-res small charms in place of two life SCs caps lightning at any HotO roll ≥ 35. Cost of the ring swap: Cannot Be Frozen, 20 cold absorb, 15 dex, 201 AR, 40 mana. The amulet route (Havoc Collar: 10 FCR, 31 light) loses +2 Warlock skills and is not worth it; Mara's has no FCR. A 35-roll Spirit would reach 125 exactly but is a coin-flip reroll. Buying a 38–40-res HotO shrinks the lightning gap by up to 10. Wizardspike resells for ~0.1 Ist (asks 2026-09-24), not a Lem. DONE 2026-09-29 (sheet 12:05 UTC: HotO 36 res in a superior 4os Flail, Blood Turn, Natalya's Soul — FCR 127, all res 75, +9 all skills, life 1,736, mana 488). Cannot Be Frozen after the swap: the Echoing Strike planner loadouts carry no CBF source and Pindle, his minions and Hell cows deal no cold, so nothing is lost on this farm loop; chill would only slow the Echoing Strike swing, never a cast. If it is wanted anyway, the only slot that costs neither skills nor FCR is the Shako socket: Cham (asks 9–16 Ist, median 10.3, 2026-09-24) in place of the Um (unsocket with a Hel from the 13 in materials + a TP scroll), which drops fire to 62 and lightning to 61 and so also needs a 13–15 all-res Grand Charm (2.6–4 Ist) or one 15-fire and one 15-lightning Large Charm. Cheaper endgame path: Chains of Honor in step 7 gives enough resist headroom that the Um can become a Cham with no charm change. Raven Frost only returns once the amulet carries 10 FCR (Caster Amulet craft with +2 Warlock, §3), and the resists it and Blood Turn provide must come from that amulet. Kira's Guardian (0.2–1 Ist low rolls), Duriel's Shell and The Spirit Shroud (both in mule stash) all cost 1–2 skills — rejected. Half Freeze Duration pieces in stash (Beast Heart amulet, Blood Finger ring) are not CBF.

heading: 3.1 Item level — why where the base comes from matters
description: Crafted ilvl = ⌊clvl/2⌋ + ⌊base ilvl/2⌋. The number of random affixes is rolled from that ilvl: at crafted ilvl ≥ 71 you get the full 1–4 (each extra affix a coin-flip chain), lower ilvl caps you at fewer. Craft on a level 90+ character with a Hell-dropped base (Pindle's pack is mlvl 86, cows 81–ish in Hell) and you are always past the cap.
